title: Cumulating Evolutionary Volatility: Automated Judgment, Dialectical Development, and the Semantic Economy of Unaccountable Composition
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A v0.4 theoretical paper defining **Cumulating Evolutionary Volatility (CEV)** as the time-integrated tendency of automated public-reality composition systems to become more unstable, personalized, state-dependent, and difficult to trace as optimization, risk management, abuse prevention, legal insulation, and commercial adaptation accumulate.

The paper reads five May 2026 cases concerning one entity across Google AI Mode, Bing AI Search, and Claude as a contradiction-shaped rather than model-generic pattern. It distinguishes Automated Judgment Insulation as institutional condition, Volatile Accountability Evasion as behavioral manifestation, and CEV as long-run development. The proposed relation `CEV = ∫ PER(t) dt` is a framework invariant, not a validated universal metric. The proposed response is accountable composition with versioning, source-window transparency, state logs, provenance appeal, and durable retention of prior states.
